text:
Maria K: Heads up — planning a staged switchover for Vesper Health (Dedicated) on Thu 2025-06-12 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~60m with monitoring gates. Target runtime/version bump from v3.4.1 to v3.5.0-rc.

Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vesper-switchover

Need: SRE approval, KMS rotation check (customer rotates keys at 02:30 UTC), and confirmation that reserved capacity is in place. Will pin tenant to the new version at slice boundaries and hold rollback thresholds at 1% 5xx OR p95 latency +40% for initial canary. @Leon P @Ajay S please review :eyes:

Leon P: Reviewing. Quick checklist: reserve burst capacity (no shared tenants on same slice), pre-warm KV cache, confirm autoscaler cooldowns won't flip during 10->50% shift. Also need KMS fallback plan if their rotation causes decrypt errors.

Ajay S: Agree with Leon. Suggest explicit rollback triggers:
- 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 5m
- p95 latency increase > 40% sustained for 10m
- error spike in model mismatch/regression tests (auto-eval fail)
If any trigger fires, cut traffic back to previous version and abort further slices.

Maria K: Good — locking those thresholds. Adding the rollback command to the runbook:
```
# rollback to pinned version
redwoodctl tenant pin --tenant vesper-health --version v3.4.1 --reason "auto-rollback"
```
I'll also add a manual fallback step for KMS: fail to cached keys and route to dedicated fallback key in the same region.

deploy-bot: preflight checks ===> certs: OK, capacity reservation: 32 gpus reserved (slice footprint verified), canary manifest applied to slice-02, healthcheck hooks registered. ETA to canary start: 1h 15m. :white_check_mark:

Dina R: Updating release notes and customer comms now. Will notify AE + SOC about the rotation collision window at 02:30 UTC. Draft blurb pinned to the ticket.

sre-monitor: Running continuous synthetic checks against staging canary. Saw a minor p95 bump (≈8%) during yesterday's smoke run, not a blocker but we should watch the first 10m of canary closely. Alerts will route to #eng-oncall and page at severity=high. :eyes:

Leon P: Approve on behalf of SRE contingent on KMS fallback being added to runbook and the rollback command tested in staging. Once tested, signal green and we'll proceed with the window.

Maria K: Thanks — I'll run the KMS fallback test in staging at 22:00 UTC tonight and post results here. Assuming green, we will start canary at 02:05 UTC (a few minutes after window opens) and follow the staged ramp. I'll also tag this thread for the post-deploy evaluation and metrics snapshot. :rocket:
